findings.description: Victoriano Macatangay's father was José, per a 1915 christening record for his son Miguel.
supporting_sources: Philippines, Catholic Church Records, 1520-2014 — christening entry for Miguel Macatangay Sisquinto, 16 Oct 1915, Batangas City, naming grandparents

findings.description: Victoriano Macatangay's mother was Bernardina Cabrera, per the same christening record.
supporting_sources: Philippines, Catholic Church Records, 1520-2014 — christening entry for Miguel Macatangay Sisquinto, 16 Oct 1915, Batangas City

findings.description: Victoriano Macatangay and Gabina Sisquinto had a son, Miguel Macatangay Sisquinto, born 28 September 1915 and christened 16 October 1915 in Batangas City, in addition to their six children already in the tree (b. 1904-1929).
supporting_sources: Philippines, Catholic Church Records, 1520-2014 — christening entry, 16 Oct 1915, Batangas City, naming parents Victorino Macatangay and Gabina Sisquinto
